IDEA 2 OF 4

What fixing a homepage looks like
=================================

Here is a made-up example, so you can see the kind of change I mean. It is not a client and these are not results.

[Before]
Headline: "Welcome to our website. We offer quality dog services."
Buttons: Call Us &middot; Get a Quote &middot; Subscribe &middot; Follow Us

[After]
Headline: "Dog walking in Vaughan. Book your first walk in 60 seconds."
Button: Book a Walk (everything else is quieter)


WHAT CHANGED

- The headline says who it is for and what they get.
- There is one clear action instead of four.
- A visitor can tell what happens after they click.

This is the kind of fix I put in your recommendations: plain words, one goal, clear next step.
